item.title: Three Birds Café to close in Winter Garden
item.description: The final day for the café will be Thursday, Feb. 26.

item.title: New ambassador at Oakland Nature Preserve
item.description: ONP welcomed Buttercup, a Virginia Opossum to its ambassador team.

item.title: Founder and CEO of Hi-Lite Academy announces separation from school
item.description: Jessica Villegas and her coaching team are no longer involved in the leadership or day-to-day operations of Hi-Lite Academy.

item.title: More downtown Winter Garden businesses unable to renew leases
item.description: Polka Dotz and Driftwood Market announced closure is near because of new building owners.

item.title: Oakland presents fourth-quarter officer awards
item.description: The Oakland Town Commission recognized the accomplishments of its police officers at the meeting Tuesday, Feb. 10.

item.title: Annual Winter Garden Musical Fest returns
item.description: It takes about 40 city employees and 260 volunteers to pull off Winter Garden’s annual Music Fest. The 12-hour concert festival returns Saturday, Feb. 21.

item.title: The Unsolved: Ocoee PD closes oldest cold case in department history
item.description: Retired detective Michelle Grogan worked with the Clermont Police Department and other agencies to identify the remains of Ernest Joe Manzanares.

item.title: Winter Garden leaders approve higher rates for farmers market vendors
item.description: The Winter Garden City Commission also approved three site plans and learned of the potential impacts property tax reform could have on the city.

item.title: AdventHealth Winter Garden CEO leads growth with patient perspective
item.description: With a new CEO, AdventHealth Winter Garden sees two expansion projects totaling $188.2 million near completion.

item.title: Windermere boathouse controversy continues
item.description: The town of Windermere heads into boathouse mediation Wednesday, Feb. 25. The Windermere Town Council has approved a resolution for a law firm to assess the viability of the appeal.
